prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE transparent environment atlas for a preschool woodland game, EXACTLY 2 columns and 2 rows. Overall image aspect 2:1, ideally 2048x1024; each cell is a landscape rectangle 1024x512, with 8% transparent margins. Reference is palette/painting style only; no bus in new art.
Paint FOUR isolated low woodland ground vignettes from a gentle elevated three-quarter camera, looking over ground toward back. Ground ONLY, no sky, tall trees, characters, buildings, text, grids or buttons. Genuine RGBA transparency outside irregular feathered earth and grass perimeter. Each vignette has a wide oval footprint occupying 85% of cell width and 70% of cell height. Fine watercolor/gouache, honey sunlight upper left, sage moss, muted fern greens, cream daisies, warm sandy earth. Detailed but quiet center; foreground blades and tiny flowers concentrated at EDGES, central 65% clear for game objects. Ground sits FLAT; no floating island, thick raised rim, cliff, pedestal or cutaway.
Top-left cell: a sunlit mossy play clearing, wide empty sandy-earth center, delicate edge grass, one little smooth stone and ferns at far corners.
Top-right: a shallow pale turquoise woodland stream crossing from left edge to right edge through the center, dry mossy banks above and below, subtle ripples and a few rounded stones, central crossing free for children to build a bridge. No existing bridge or planks.
Bottom-left: woodland picnic clearing with a softly folded peach-and-cream gingham cloth laid FLAT across center ground, little moss, daisies and ferns around perimeter. No dishes, food, basket or characters.
Bottom-right: woodland music clearing with a broad very low horizontal weathered honey-oak log across the center, detailed warm wood grain, moss at ends, small ferns at outer corners. Top of log clear for instruments.
Strict independent 2x2 cells; do not let any object reach neighboring cell. Same light and texture as existing forest. Actual transparency, no checkerboard paint.
